author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding E, counting groups of three, echoing short patterns and taking turns, using a happy song about friends rolling along together.

classes.title: Roll your arms along
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and roll your arms each time you hear 'roll along'.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing the same words come back and moving each time

classes.parentPrompt: Roll your arms round and round like wheels every time the song says 'roll along'.
classes.childAction: Roll your arms like wheels on every 'roll along'.
classes.bridge: The tune rolls like a little wagon wheel, round and round.

intro.caption: Let's roll like wheels
intro.parentCue: roll your arms each time you hear roll along

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for words that come back.

classes.title: Wheels keep turning
classes.goal: Tap a steady beat on any key while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more and no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on every beat, steady like a wheel.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one turn of the wheel: even, never in a rush.

intro.caption: One beat, one turn
intro.parentCue: tap your child's knee on every beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: E, E, E, we roll along
classes.goal: Find E by the two black keys and play it three times in a row.

mathTarget.parentLine: Seeing and hearing three without counting one by one

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up three fingers for 'we roll along', then help your child find E.
classes.childAction: Find E and play it three times: we, roll, along.
classes.bridge: E sits just right of the two black keys, like a wheel by a gate.

intro.caption: Three Es: we roll along!
intro.parentCue: find the two black keys, then slide to E

games.caption: We roll along: E, E, E
games.parentCue: Count one, two, three with each E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E and seeing three at a glance.

classes.title: Big wheel, little wheel
classes.goal: Find E in two places: a low E and a high E with the same name.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same note lives in a low house and a high house

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the low E, then the high E. Say 'big wheel' low, 'little wheel' high.
classes.childAction: Hop from the low E to the high E and back.
classes.bridge: Every E sits right of two black keys; the low one rumbles, the high one rings.

intro.caption: Two Es, two houses
intro.parentCue: point to the low E, then the high E

games.caption: Hop: low E, high E
games.parentCue: Say big wheel, little wheel as they hop

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the same note low and high.

classes.title: Roll down, roll up
classes.goal: Echo short patterns that roll down the hill and back up again.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same three steps, going down and then coming up

classes.parentPrompt: Roll your hands down your child's arm, then back up, as the notes move.
classes.childAction: Echo the notes rolling down, then rolling back up.
classes.bridge: E, D, C rolls down the hill to the left; C, D, E rolls back.

intro.caption: Down the hill, up the hill
intro.parentCue: roll your hands down and up their arm

games.caption: Roll down: E, D, C
games.parentCue: Say 'down, down, down' as they play

games.caption: Roll up: C, D, E
games.parentCue: Say 'up, up, up' as they play

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: patterns that go down and come back up.

classes.title: Roll along, roll along
classes.goal: Echo the 'roll along' notes: three the same, then a hop up.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing a tiny tune and keeping it in mind to copy

classes.parentPrompt: Play or sing each pattern, pause, then nod to your child: 'Your turn.'
classes.childAction: Listen, then copy: D, D, D, then E, G, G.
classes.bridge: Three wheels in a row on D, then the wagon hops up the hill.

intro.caption: I roll first, then you
intro.parentCue: nod to your child for their turn

games.caption: Roll along: E, G, G
games.parentCue: Point to G, the hop up

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing short patterns and copying them back.

classes.title: Wait for the wagon's E
classes.goal: Wait and play E at the right moments while the grown-up plays the rest.

mathTarget.parentLine: I play my notes, you play yours: we take turns

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes, then look at your child and nod just before each E.
classes.childAction: Wait with your finger ready, then play E when it lights.
classes.bridge: The grown-up drives the wagon; you ring the E bell at each stop.

intro.caption: You are the E bell
intro.parentCue: nod just before each E comes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn and playing on time.

classes.title: Two bells: E and D
classes.goal: Play two special notes, E and D, and tell them apart by ear and by place.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting notes into two groups: E notes and D notes

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'E' or 'D' aloud before each one; cheer for every one your child catches.
classes.childAction: Play E or D when it lights. Two neighbours, two bells.
classes.bridge: D sits between the two black keys; E is its neighbour on the right.

intro.caption: Two bells: D and E
intro.parentCue: touch D, then E, and name each one

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling two notes apart by ear and place.

classes.title: Rolling along together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one steady beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping the same steady beat

classes.parentPrompt: Keep the beat going even if a note is missed; smile and nod at each turn.
classes.childAction: Play your notes in time with your grown-up's beat.
classes.bridge: Two friends, one wagon: the wheels turn together, round and round.

intro.caption: Two friends, one wagon
intro.parentCue: sit close and keep the beat steady

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: sharing one beat and taking turns.

classes.title: Over the deep blue sea
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and land softly on the last long note.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, travels along, and stops at home

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; hold the last note long, then clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, hold the last note, then bow.
classes.bridge: The last long C is home: the friends stop rolling and rest.

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song and landing at the end.
